title: A table draws a rule between its body rows
body:
coax lays a table out through cmr with no line between body rows. When a cell wraps, its row takes several lines, and nothing shows where one row ends and the next begins. cmr-420714 adds `rules: bool` to `cmr::Block::Table`. With the flag set, cmr draws the header rule again between body rows.

## Proposal

- `rule_tables` in `src/ui.rs` sets `rules` on every table in a parse, quoted ones included, the way `wrap_code` sets `wrap` on code blocks.
- `markdown` calls it on an agent message, and `markdown_view` calls it on a rendered `markdown` fence.

## Rejected

- A `┌ table   rules` header row on each table, with a click on `rules` switching the rules per table. It was built and tried, and Jack chose rules on every table with no toggle. The header row went with the toggle, since it held nothing else.

## Out of scope

- Command output from a tool, laid out by `output_rows`, keeps cmr's default of no rules.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/85c47808
notes.text:
Done in the working tree on `dev`, not yet committed. cmr's side is in the cmr working tree under cmr-420714.

Every table is now a `Part::Block`. `kept_whole` lays it out twice, without rules and with them, and puts a `┌ table` row above each layout. The second layout sits in `KeptBlock::ruled`, boxed so `Part` stays small. The header row has no selection text, and each link run moves down one row to make room for it. `block_view` takes a `rules` flag and shows the ruled rows when it is set.

The header row draws when a block has a copy or a `ruled` layout. A table has no copy, so its header row has no copy glyph. `Toggle::active` is now an `Option<Word>`, so a lone word like `rules` can show with no word in force. `App::rules` holds the keys switched on, and a click on `Word::Rules` adds or removes the key.

Checked in tmux at 100 columns: a click on `rules` adds a rule between each pair of rows in that table alone.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/85c47808
notes.text: Done in the working tree on `dev`, not yet committed. The toggle version was dropped before it was committed. The test `a_table_has_a_rule_between_its_rows_in_the_prose_and_in_a_quote` covers both places.
